findings.title: C03 lifecycle snapshot authorization is not bound to the requested tenant
findings.evidence: snapshot authorizes only the generic READ capability before accepting arbitrary id, then returns safeSnapshot for that id. The target tenant ID is never passed to authorize; safeSnapshot includes creationKey, configRefs, resourceNamespaceId, lifecycleEvents, and outbox.
findings.recommendation: Bind the requested tenant ID and read scope to the authorization decision, and reject a caller whose authorized tenant scope does not match id; add a cross-tenant snapshot denial test.

findings.title: F04 release gate can PASS an unbound release digest
findings.evidence: The evaluator checks report.suite_id at lines 148-150 but never requires, validates, or compares report.release_digest; line 171 merely returns report.release_digest ?? null. The F04 README requires every passing record to bind both suite_id and release_digest, while the tests cover suite and result failures but no missing or mismatched release digest.
findings.recommendation: Make an expected immutable release digest an input bound to the frozen suite/config, require an exact valid digest match before PASS, and add missing and mismatched-digest fail-closed tests.

findings.title: F03 compatibility checker omits request-side breaking changes
findings.evidence: findBreakingChanges traverses prior paths, operations, responses, and component schemas, but does not inspect operation.parameters, requestBody, requestBody.required, request content types, or inline request schemas. A candidate can therefore add a required request header/body field or narrow an inline request schema and be reported COMPATIBLE. The frozen mutation tests cover only the listed eight categories and omit these request-side mutations.
findings.recommendation: Compare every operation's parameters and requestBody recursively, including requiredness, content types, schemas, and referenced schemas; add negative fixtures for newly required headers/body fields and request-schema narrowing.

findings.title: Lifecycle runtime role can forge a tenant scope and delete or alter another tenant's data
findings.evidence: The lifecycle policies at lines 84-99 authorize the lifecycle role for every tenant data table via lifecycle_scope_matches, and lines 132-152 grant that role DELETE on all data tables plus INSERT/UPDATE on lifecycle state. lifecycle_scope_matches in implementation/p1/c07/postgresql/0011_tenant_data_isolation.sql lines 365-378 only compares row tenant values with caller-controlled current_setting('aios.tenant_id'/'aios.tenant_kind'); unlike runtime_scope_allows it verifies no HMAC, backend PID, transaction ID, expiry, lifecycle version, or C03 event receipt. A session using aios_c07_lifecycle_runtime can set those custom GUCs to another tenant and satisfy the RLS policy, so NOBYPASSRLS does not prevent cross-tenant mutation/deletion.
findings.recommendation: Do not make lifecycle-table/data-table RLS depend solely on caller-set GUCs. Bind lifecycle mutations to a non-forgeable, transaction-scoped capability verified by a SECURITY DEFINER function (including the exact trusted C03 event/tenant/version), expose only that narrow operation to the lifecycle role, and add an integration test that attempts cross-tenant DELETE/UPDATE after setting arbitrary aios.* GUCs as aios_c07_lifecycle_runtime.

findings.title: Recall plaintext can be returned after item authorization is revoked
findings.evidence: The per-memory C06 decision is obtained at lines 2144-2162, then only C05 identity is re-resolved at lines 2172-2185. `readRecallContent` subsequently retrieves plaintext at lines 2187-2193 and that plaintext is appended to the response at lines 2194-2203. There is no second item authorization decision after the content read or immediately before delivery, so an ACL/policy revocation occurring after line 2162 can still cause the already-revoked memory body to be returned.
findings.recommendation: Add a final C06 item authorization and identity/security-binding recheck after `readRecallContent` and before appending plaintext; discard the fetched value on any denial/change. Prefer a delivery gate that is coherently bound to the content version read so a revoked or changed item cannot pass between check and response.

findings.title: 已入队 Effect 可在其 Decision 过期后被领取并执行
findings.evidence: claim_effect_outbox 的候选条件仅检查 tenant、Outbox status、available_at 和 lease_until（1060-1073），未关联 synthetic_test_decision 或 decision_withdrawal，也未检查 Decision 的 expires_at。Worker 在领取后直接 adapter.commit(effect)（lib/c15-outbox-worker.mjs:63），且 complete_effect 同样只校验 lease、Effect 状态和哈希（1120-1239）。因此可在 expiresAt 前通过 execute 原子入队、等待 expiresAt 后由 Worker 执行；这与本段 C15-A06 所述“Expiry ... fail closed”不一致。
findings.recommendation: 在真实 commit 边界重新验证 Decision 的有效性：将领取/执行授权与 effect 的 Decision 绑定，拒绝已过期或已失效的 Effect，并增加“入队时有效、Worker 领取时已过期，adapter.commit 不得调用”的 Memory 与 PostgreSQL 集成测试。若设计上授权在入队时即不可撤销，也必须显式冻结该语义并使 expiresAt 不再被宣称为执行阶段失效条件。

findings.title: 生命周期投影未校验状态转换，已删除租户可被后续事件重新激活
findings.evidence: projectUnlocked 仅以 current.lifecycleVersion + 1 校验事件顺序（373-377），随后按事件类型直接创建目录或删除目录并写入目标状态（379-399）；它没有将 current.state 与 event.type 组成允许转换表。由于 project 作为适配器公开方法导出（408-417、453-458），一个版本连续但语义非法的 product.tenant.activated.v1 事件可在 DELETED 后走 387-399，重建租户目录并写回 ACTIVE。
findings.recommendation: 在 projectUnlocked 中引入并强制执行前置状态到事件类型的闭合转换表（包含首事件和终态 DELETED）；对任何未列出的转换失败关闭。新增直接调用 project 的测试，覆盖 DELETED→ACTIVE、DELETED→PROVISIONING、NOT_PROVISIONED→ACTIVE 及重复删除等非法序列。
